status_legend.asm_verified: Main behavior is backed by a concrete ASM branch/address and implemented to match it.
status_legend.asm_partial: Some behavior is backed by ASM, but important details are still unknown or approximated.
status_legend.data_verified: Asset/mapping details are confirmed from game data/Camoto, but runtime behavior may not be fully ASM-traced.
status_legend.heuristic: Implemented from visual testing or inferred behavior; needs ASM/data confirmation.
status_legend.known_wrong: Known to differ from the original game.
status_legend.unimplemented: Not implemented, placeholder, or prototype only.

notes: Pass 123 corrects pass 122: wall-blocked raw 0xA7 pushes are not the object-0xAA/state-0x1389 score rewrite. Pass 124 tried to wait for crossed-through + front-wall probes, but pass 125 corrects the timing: raw 0xA7/state 0x1388 remains body-pass-through/top-solid until the player leading shrunken x+3..x+12 edge crosses the barrel leading shrunken edge, then it restores just outside the same shrunken interval (~10px), before full-sprite wall contact. Pass 126 fixes the live polling bug where pass-through barrels were skipped by the atomic horizontal path and therefore never restored. The exact wall-push caller/store and DOSBox pixel timing are still open. Pass 127 removes the unsupported reuse of the player DS:34AF gravity table for barrel fall and makes ordinary barrel push/fall use a named 4px actor-step reconstruction; exact pushed-off-edge state/store timing remains open.

Pass 128 adds an explicit falling lock so a pushed-off-edge raw 0xA7 cannot be side-pushed farther while unsupported; this is a guarded reconstruction from the actor X/Y direction separation at SAM1:0x81C8..0x8288 plus DOS observation, with the exact unsupported-transition store still open.

Pass 130 fixes a one-tile doorway regression: horizontal-first probing rejected a jump/fall entry while Y was one pixel misaligned; the runtime now lets the BC0E vertical step/snap run before the B7D9 horizontal destination probe, and tools/check_player_motion_accuracy.py protects that case.

Pass 131 corrects an off-by-one in the vertical step table: ASM initializes 0x34B0=0 and indexes it as byte[0x34AF+DS:34EA], so the first jump tick has 0px movement and the early fall after the apex is 1,1,2,2,2px, restoring the tile-aligned doorway frame.
